newsitem.title: LEBANON: Lebanon says it ready for Arab Games.
newsitem.headline: Lebanon says it ready for Arab Games.

text.p: Lebanon said on Wednesday it was ready to host the Arab Games starting on July 12 although a covered hall being built for indoor sports will not be ready.

Outdoor events would be held in a 50,000-seat open-air stadium which is nearing completion and indoor sports would take place in different facilities around Beirut, Sports Minister Jean Obeid told a news conference.
"Lebanon is ready for the Arab games which will be a great Arab event in Beirut," Obeid said.
Zeid Khyami, sports minister director-general, said 18 Arab states had confirmed their participation but the organising committee was awaiting confirmation from three other countries.
Khyami said these included Kuwait, whose government had informed the organizing committee of the possibility that it would boycott the games if Iraq participated.
The new open-air stadium under construction for four years replaces one destroyed by Israeli bombing during Israel's 1982 invasion of Lebanon.
Delays in building the stadium caused the postponement of the Arab Games which were originally scheduled for last September. Workers are currently putting the finishing touches on the stadium.
